'''Matilde''' is a servant in the [[Tarasin Palace]]. She is skinny and a little older than Mistress [[Carin]]. She wears a [[marriage knife]].

==Activities==
When [[Mat]] wants to see [[Nynaeve]] and [[Elayne]], Matilde takes him from Carin to [[Bren]], two other servants in the Tarasin Palace.
